title: Close paid CRT source updates for uninterrupted row execution
body:
This construction closes the **paid CRT source-update and row-reentry boundary**. The existing physical query's returned coordinate stream now updates the same owned axis-record tape and feeds the next row without host serialization. Complete forward and reverse levels execute on that tape. The new source-relative proof covers any admitted fixed-node row sequence. Complete kappa is unchanged; whole-tree and exceptional-key composition remain open.

[Implementation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c36a72644322913866041e061912893a8f210ad5/research/crt-paid-row-reentry/reentry.py), [proof and complete bill](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c36a72644322913866041e061912893a8f210ad5/research/crt-paid-row-reentry/PROOF.md), [receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c36a72644322913866041e061912893a8f210ad5/research/crt-paid-row-reentry/RESULT.json), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c36a72644322913866041e061912893a8f210ad5/research/crt-paid-row-reentry/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c36a72644322913866041e061912893a8f210ad5/research/crt-paid-row-reentry/SOURCES.json). Base: canonical main 6cf7a683f447b9f1e2333791907fd92be5009a63, priority 7. The unchanged joined query is JoyboyBrian's [PR #5496](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5496), source head a99afd7e0024af8367d5a2f6f4d2da57a1d13dd5 ([consumed archived proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6cf7a683f447b9f1e2333791907fd92be5009a63/research/crt-current-row-query/PROOF.md)). The handoff and exact bank formula are from commdata2338's [PR #5519](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5519), source head 53a034436f17ef5b8fdf7a02f5066528cdfe5446 ([consumed archived proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6cf7a683f447b9f1e2333791907fd92be5009a63/research/crt-multitarget-row-audit/PROOF.md)).

A paid temporary stream preserves the result while the old query closes, so the source borrow ends before its coordinate fields change. Every added scan and copy is charged. Distinct row workspaces remain retained and their capacities are summed. The predecessor's exact 52-role ROM-bank count is used for each active row. The two-target round trip retains 24314 work cells against a 27620-cell bound; source and protected input backing are additional.

Normal and optimized registered checks pass: four uninterrupted forward/reverse fixtures, 40 row invocations, 30 unchanged physical ROM calls and five adapter mutants. Each fixture has one initial serialization. Checks cover actual padded intermediates, two targets, a nonroot node, all-idle rows, invalid-left disabling, source identity/extent, protected dirty words, every retired bank, staging erasure and complete bills. Committed-byte, export-integrity and Git-free optimized replay checks pass.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/crt-paid-row-reentry
```

Python 3.12 and the standard library suffice. Expected markers: `PASS_CRT_PAID_ROW_REENTRY rows=40 producer_calls=30 controls=5` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

The numerical Entry, joined query and ROM producer theorems remain inherited hypotheses. The retained logical Caller is the test oracle and supplies no runtime values. Initial encoded-source production, arbitrary dirty workspace acquisition, cross-row bank reuse, changing-precision whole-tree entry, complete three-epoch keys, global key transport, binary numerical lowering and full E/native/ordinary/outer admission remain open. No selected cold replay, full source-history ancestry, independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. The checkout is shallow; hosted CI is separate. The selected frontier and all predecessor files are unchanged.

Credit Ali Romman's [PR #5353](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5353) RowEntry; JoyboyBrian's [PR #5092](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5092), [PR #5219](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5219) and [PR #5053](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5053) ROM and numerical components; ToikY's [PR #4195](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4195) explicit-width caller and [PR #4192](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4192) arena refinement; Hiroki KUMAZAKI's [PR #4716](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4716) current-state contract; and Cinna Davis's [PR #4100](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4100) CRT construction. Retain Tekalign, Jose Manuel, Ryanson Jonathan, unpaidmoon, Douglas Colkitt, John-Michael Smith and the source notices. [Coordination](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4709#discussioncomment-19185368). Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
